title: IoT Integration Approaches into Personalized Online Learning
content: Background: The integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) in education has trans-formed Personalized Online Learning (POL), enabling adaptive, context aware and learner-centered environments through interconnected devices and real-time data anal-ysis; Methods: This review systematically explores various IoT integration technological and pedagogical approaches in POL systems, including things, communication tech-nologies, context-aware mechanisms, integration frameworks, computing technologies and implemented pedagogical approaches. By examining 61 peer-reviewed studies, the study categorizes IoT technological and pedagogical approaches, evaluates their impact on personalization and identifies challenges such as data privacy and resource con-straints; Results: Key findings reveal that IoT-enhanced POL can significantly improve learner engagement, adaptive learning and academic outcomes; Conclusions: Gaps in interoperability standards, learner profiling, cognitive load modeling and the ethical use of data highlight the need for a unified framework. The paper concludes with pro-posing an IoT based POL framework and recommendations for future research and practical applications, emphasizing IoT’s transformative potential in creating personal-ized and inclusive learning environments.
